integrity_statement: All claimed integer counts follow from analytic spectral reductions and a standalone exhaustive exact-rank certificate, with an independent full-state reachability cross-check for a controllable and an uncontrollable example. This is not an independent external mathematical audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed, unit-weight, 30-vertex Tutte–Coxeter incidence graph and independent coordinate input matrices. Does not address larger generalized quadrangles, weighted links, control energy or perturbation robustness. The mixed-eigenspace classification uses a complete, deterministic finite rank certificate.
title: Ten-coordinate controllability and the ovoid–spread exception in the Tutte–Coxeter graph
